problem: WP507 matched causal probes do not structurally bind the non-intervention execution context. Same probe_id and nonbroadcast_input_sha256 can be used across different runner/model/config/environment contexts; if outputs differ, current logic can attribute the difference to the broadcast intervention.

proposed_delta.construction_rule: Both CausalProbeArm factories consume the same concrete typed context object and serialize its canonical digest. Do not expose a naked arbitrary digest as the only construction input.
proposed_delta.matching_rule: If intervention.execution_context_sha256 != control.execution_context_sha256, evaluate_causal_influence returns UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL.
proposed_delta.wp510_rule: Revalidate the WP507 context-bound arm/result chain; do not create a second context schema or authority.
proposed_delta.intervention_boundary: Broadcast identity is excluded from the shared context digest because it is the declared manipulated dimension.

acceptance_tests: Preregister/reproduce the existing confounded pair against exact pre-change WP507.
After candidate implementation, the same pair must become UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL solely because typed execution-context digests differ.
Equal typed execution contexts must preserve existing positive/no-causal/unknown semantics under all other current WP507 prerequisites.
Wrong or stale context generation/digest must fail closed.
Factories must reject nominal or malformed context values according to the current exact-type/factory ABI style.
Broadcast intervention identity must remain outside the shared context digest.
WP510 G3 NOT_COMPUTED positive-seal fence must remain intact.
All existing WP507 and WP510 tests/CI must pass at successor scope.
No added model calls/tokens. Measure storage bytes, hash/validation p50/p95/p99, CPU/RSS/I/O on the admitted Trigger4 surface.
falsifiers: Current exact source already has a mandatory typed execution-context object consumed and compared across both arms; if found, reject duplicate implementation and reuse it.
Equivalent negative regression fails to reproduce on the exact current predecessor source; if so, stop and reconcile before implementation.
Typed context cannot exclude the intervention dimension without losing required confound identity; if so, redesign rather than weakening matching.
risks: Overbinding stochastic or intentionally variable dimensions could turn legitimate experiments into UNKNOWN.
Underbinding runner/model/config/environment dimensions preserves the confound.
Duplicating a context object in WP507 and WP510 would create drift/second-authority risk.
A context digest proves declared field equality only, not world truth or hidden-state causality.
